import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class LuckyTicketsV1 {

    private static final int MOD = 998244353;
    private static final int twoPow = 23;
    private static final int ROOT = 15311432;

    private static int bitReverse(int n, int k) {
        return Integer.reverse(n) >>> (32 - k);
    }

    private static long modPow(long a, long p) {
        long res = 1;
        while (p > 0) {
            if ((p & 1) == 1) {
                res = (res * a) % MOD;
            }
            a = (a * a) % MOD;
            p >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    private static long modInv(long a) {
        return modPow(a, MOD - 2);
    }

    private static long[] calcRoots(int k, boolean inverse) {
        long root = modPow(ROOT, modPow(2, twoPow - k));
        if (inverse) {
            root = modInv(root);
        }
        long[] roots = new long[k];
        roots[k - 1] = root;
        for (int i = k - 1; i > 0; i--) {
            roots[i - 1] = (roots[i] * roots[i]) % MOD;
        }
        return roots;
    }

    private static long[] reorderArray(long[] a, int k) {
        long[] ans = new long[a.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
            ans[bitReverse(i, k)] = a[i];
        }
        return ans;
    }

    private static long[] numberTheoreticTransform(long[] coef, int k, boolean inverse) {
        coef = reorderArray(coef, k);
        long[] roots = calcRoots(k, inverse);
        int len = 1;
        for (int s = 0; s < k; s++) {
            int step = len * 2;
            for (int st = 0; st < coef.length; st += step) {
                long curRoot = 1;
                for (int j = st; j < st + len; j++) {
                    long t = (curRoot * coef[j + len]) % MOD;
                    long u = coef[j];
                    coef[j] = (u + t) % MOD;
                    coef[j + len] = (u - t) % MOD;
                    curRoot = (roots[s] * curRoot) % MOD;
                }
            }
            len = step;
        }
        return coef;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt() / 2;
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int[] nums = new int[m];
        int max = 0;
        int idx = 0;
        while (idx < m) {
            nums[idx] = sc.nextInt();
            if (nums[idx] > max) max = nums[idx];
            idx++;
        }
        int minSize = n * max + 1;
        int k = 0;
        int size = 1;
        while (size < minSize) {
            size <<= 1;
            k++;
        }
        long[] a = new long[size];
        for (int i = 0; i < nums.length; i++) {
            a[nums[i]] = 1;
        }
        a = numberTheoreticTransform(a, k, false);
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            a[i] = modPow(a[i], n);
        }
        a = numberTheoreticTransform(a, k, true);
        long ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            ans = (ans + a[i] * a[i]) % MOD;
        }
        long multiplier = modInv(size);
        System.out.println((((ans * multiplier) % MOD) * multiplier) % MOD);
    }
}

import java.math.BigInteger;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class LuckyTicketsV4 {

    private static final int twoPow = 23;
    private static final BigInteger ROOT = BigInteger.valueOf(15311432);

    }

    private static BigInteger modPow(BigInteger a, BigInteger p) {
        if (p.equals(BigInteger.ZERO)) return BigInteger.ONE;
        BigInteger half = modPow(a, p.divide(BigInteger.valueOf(2)));
        BigInteger ans = half.multiply(half).mod(MOD);
        if (p.mod(BigInteger.valueOf(2)).equals(BigInteger.ONE)) {
            ans = ans.multiply(a).mod(MOD);
        }
        return ans;
    }

    private static BigInteger modInv(BigInteger a) {
        return modPow(a, MOD.subtract(BigInteger.valueOf(2)));
    }

    private static BigInteger[] calcRoots(int k, boolean inverse) {
        BigInteger root = modPow(ROOT, modPow(BigInteger.valueOf(2), BigInteger.valueOf(twoPow - k)));
        if (inverse) root = modInv(root);
        BigInteger[] roots = new BigInteger[k];
        roots[k - 1] = root;
        for (int i = k - 1; i > 0; i--) {
            roots[i - 1] = roots[i].multiply(roots[i]).mod(MOD);
        }
        return roots;
    }

    private static BigInteger[] reorderArray(BigInteger[] a, int k) {
        BigInteger[] ans = new BigInteger[a.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
            ans[bitReverse(i, k)] = a[i];
        }
        return ans;
    }

    private static BigInteger[] numberTheoreticTransform(BigInteger[] coef, int k, boolean inverse) {
        coef = reorderArray(coef, k);
        BigInteger[] roots = calcRoots(k, inverse);
        for (int s = 0; s < k; s++) {
            int len = 1 << s;
            for (int st = 0; st < coef.length; st += 2 * len) {
                BigInteger curRoot = BigInteger.ONE;
                for (int j = st; j < st + len; j++) {
                    BigInteger t = curRoot.multiply(coef[j + len]).mod(MOD);
                    BigInteger u = coef[j];
                    coef[j] = u.add(t).mod(MOD);
                    coef[j + len] = u.subtract(t).mod(MOD);

        return coef;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
